entries.observed_need: A single title can be simultaneously LIVE in paperback, BLOCKED in Kindle and NOT_CREATED in hardcover, so Book Factory must track format artifacts, format-specific QA and per-format publication state independently.
entries.recommended_action: Keep format publication fail-closed and supervised; never create duplicate editions or infer total-project failure from one blocked format.

entries.observed_need: Durable mission state, explicit human gates, fail-closed integrity and resumable evidence are needed around a real runtime validation.
entries.recommended_action: Keep at the ABVX boundary; consider shared extraction only after a second real project demonstrates the same need.

entries.observed_need: Event freshness, source health and editorial coverage need conservative report-only observability with explicit UNKNOWN state.
entries.recommended_action: Record the pattern; do not extract into ABVX until a second real project demonstrates the same need.

entries.observed_need: Configured sources need separate observation health from event absence; no evidence must remain UNKNOWN.
entries.recommended_action: Retain as a project lesson and wait for a second project need before extraction.

entries.observed_need: Operators need a deterministic human report plus machine-readable evidence without autonomous editorial decisions.
entries.recommended_action: Keep report-only and project-local; Rule of Two is not met.

entries.observed_need: Events and practical guides inside one project both require conservative freshness observability, but their evidence models differ.
entries.recommended_action: Keep project-local for now; reconsider shared extraction only after a second real project demonstrates the pattern.

entries.observed_need: Event sources and guide content need separate provenance-health reporting; absence of evidence must remain explicit.
entries.recommended_action: Record the repeated within-project pattern; do not extract shared ABVX code under the current Rule of Two.

entries.observed_need: Guide claims need bounded read-only verification records that can influence freshness without rewriting public content.
entries.recommended_action: Keep project-local; do not extract a shared framework before a second project demonstrates the same claim-verification boundary.

entries.observed_need: Detected differences must become explicit editorial review proposals, never silent public-content mutations.
entries.recommended_action: Retain the VERIFY -> PROPOSE -> HUMAN/EDITORIAL APPROVAL -> UPDATE boundary; no shared extraction yet.

entries.observed_need: Volatility classes suggest different future verification cadence, but observations are not yet sufficient to schedule automatically.
entries.recommended_action: Record cadence guidance; do not build a scheduler or daemon.

entries.observed_need: Arbitrary owner material needs one local preservation and advisory-routing boundary before downstream taxonomy or project priority is chosen.
entries.recommended_action: Keep as the canonical ABVX intake boundary; add one explicit source integration only after human review of this MVP.

entries.observed_need: A canonical intake archive needs explicit human decisions and idempotent promotion into only existing downstream record types.
entries.recommended_action: Keep promotion human-triggered and local; add no autonomous router or missing subsystem until a real source integration is approved.

entries.observed_need: A direct-booking project needs aggregate content-to-apartment-to-inquiry continuity, but accepted requests do not prove confirmed bookings or revenue.
entries.recommended_action: Keep attribution and observation project-local until a second project demonstrates the same boundary or a confirmed-booking source is approved; do not add a CRM, tracker or dashboard yet.

entries.observed_need: A normal human-created guide can move through intake, editorial structure, localization, provenance, publication and attribution, but Media Event handoff and publication-plan synchronization are not yet canonical.
entries.recommended_action: Observe a second human-created publication before extracting shared automation; keep factual review, translations, image approval and distribution human/editorial.

entries.observed_need: Operational control-plane state and long-term knowledge need separate canonical owners, otherwise ABVX absorbs memory scope it should not own.
entries.recommended_action: Keep ABVX operational-only; add a read-only Cortex bridge only after fixing Index Cortex source-admission hygiene.

entries.observed_need: Agents need a small task-specific ContextRequest/ContextPack contract so they stop reconstructing full project history for routine work.
entries.recommended_action: Do not build a full compiler yet; first establish a read-only bridge and clean domain source admission.

entries.observed_need: Long-term retrieval quality depends on explicit approved source roots; runtime/cache/session directories must fail closed instead of being filtered after broad recursive scans.
entries.recommended_action: Keep source admission explicit and test-backed before introducing any ABVX read-only bridge or broader cross-project retrieval.

entries.observed_need: Future consumers need a bounded read-only context bridge so they can retrieve minimum sufficient operational and knowledge context without reconstructing full project history or coupling to Cortex internals.
entries.recommended_action: Keep the bridge read-only and budgeted; next work should deepen the weakest upstream retrieval surface before broad consumer rollout.
